description: [Tauri Apps Only] Execute JavaScript in a Tauri app's webview context. Requires active driver_session. Has access to window.__TAURI__. If you need a return value, it must be JSON-serializable. For functions that return values, use an IIFE: "(() => { return 5; })()" not "() => { return 5; }". Targets the only connected app, or the default app if multiple are connected. Specify appIdentifier (port or bundle ID) to target a specific app. For browser JS execution, use Chrome DevTools MCP instead.

appIdentifier.description: App port or bundle ID to target. Defaults to the only connected app or the default app if multiple are connected.

args.description: Arguments to pass to the script

script.description: JavaScript code to execute in the webview context. If returning a value, it must be JSON-serializable. For functions that return values, use IIFE syntax: "(() => { return value; })()" not "() => { return value; }"

name: webview_execute_js
